title: Continuity from above for the shrinking level bands K ∩ f⁻¹((a − 1/(j+1), b + 1/(j+1)))
statement: For every P ∈ ℕ, every measure μ on ℝ^P, every closed set K ⊆ ℝ^P with μ(K) < ∞, every function f : ℝ^P → ℝ that is continuous on K, and all reals a, b: as j → ∞ through ℕ, μ(K ∩ f⁻¹((a − 1/(j+1), b + 1/(j+1)))) → μ(K ∩ f⁻¹([a, b])) in [0, ∞] (open intervals (·,·) = Ioo, closed interval [a, b] = Icc, 1/(j+1) computed in ℝ).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (K : Set (Eucl P)) (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), IsClosed K → ContinuousOn f K → μ K < ∞ → Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => μ (K ∩ f ⁻¹' Ioo (a - 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1)) (b + 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1)))) atTop (𝓝 (μ (K ∩ f ⁻¹' Icc a b)))
